### Auto-resolved by Diagnostic Resolver

All fingerprints in this issue found in **Tuya Unified Zigbee v9.0.672**:
- `_TZE204_mpbki2zm` -> **wall_thermostat**

**Install:** https://homey.app/a/com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee/test/
Remove and re-pair your device after installing.


> **Protocol:** Tuya DP (cluster 0xEF00). Ensure DP listeners active.
**Troubleshooting:** https://github.com/dlnraja/com.tuya.zigbee/wiki/Troubleshooting

> **Detected protocols:** tuya_dp

**Supported on master (P2234 lock + P2293 FCU TX/RX) — Test app v9.0.672+**

Couple `_TZE204_mpbki2zm` + `TS0601` (TYBAC-006 / BAC006 FCU) pairs as **Wall Thermostat**.

Runtime now maps Z2M-aligned DPs for this couple:
- DP1 on/off
- DP2 system_mode → `cool` / `heat` / `fan_only` (`thermostat_mode`)
- DP16/24 setpoint & local temp (÷10)
- DP28 `fan_mode` → low/medium/high/auto
- DP40 child lock / DP101 manual vs schedule

Please install the **Test** build and re-pair if the device was added before this fix. Feedback on fan + mode TX/RX welcome.

I have updated to v9.0.675 and repaired the device. It now correctly registers as a wall thermostat and has the correct capabilities in the app but none of the controls actually work and it is not displaying the current temperature either. I have tried changing the target temp, turning the device on/off with the app but they have no effect on the device. Please let me know if there is any info I can provide to help :)

**P2300 fix shipped on master** — root cause: `wall_thermostat` never called `super.onNodeInit`, so DeviceIO / EF00 attach + DP query never ran. Caps looked correct, TX/RX were dead (matches your 9.0.675 re-pair report).

Also hardened:
- EF00 RX attach via `_resolveTuyaCluster`
- FCU DP query after pair (`requestDP` / `queryAllDPs`)
- Late MFR-ENSURE re-arms FCU path
- Buffer-safe DP parse

**Please:** update to the next **Test** build after Auto-Publish (~9.0.677+), remove the device, re-pair as Wall Thermostat, then try on/off + setpoint + fan/mode. If anything still fails, send a diagnostic report ID from device settings.

**Update (P2300 publish follow-up)**

`9.0.677` did **not** include the FCU TX/RX fix — Auto-Publish was blocked by a fingerprint collision on an unrelated contact couple (`_TZ3000_pjb1ua0m`). That is now cleared and a new Test build is publishing.

If Homey showed **Unknown ZigBee Device** on 9.0.677, wait for the next Test build after this push (should be **9.0.678+**), then:

Thanks for diag `8cc4aef0` — I will cross-check it against the new build.

Progress! I have updated to 9.0.678 and now can turn the AC ON using the app. Unfortunately I cannot turn it back off and the app seems to crash when I try interacting with the device and I have to select Restart App in Homey. I have published diagnostic 8c49c683-294c-4965-ade1-e165c56a06e9

**P2300 is now on Homey Test** (Auto-Publish succeeded).

Please update to the latest Test build, remove the AC thermostat, and re-pair as **Wall Thermostat**. On/off, setpoint, local temp, fan/mode should work after that.

If anything still fails, reply with the new diagnostic ID.

**Root cause found in diag `8c49c683` (P2301)**

Turning OFF crashed the app with `Maximum call stack size exceeded` in `safeSetCapabilityValue` ↔ `setCapabilityValue` (that is why ON worked but OFF / further interaction needed Restart App).

Fix is on master and publishing to Test now. After the next build (**9.0.679+**):
1. Update Test
2. Restart the app once (or re-pair if still wedged)
3. Try ON **and** OFF again

Sorry for the churn — this one was a real stack overflow, not a missing DP.

**P2301 code is on master (`9.0.679`)** — recursion crash fix is committed.

Athom marked draft **#3009** as `processing_failed` (transient processor / P139). I am **not** force-republishing in a loop. Homey Test may still show **9.0.678** until Athom accepts the next draft.

When a new Test build appears (**9.0.679+**), update + restart the app (or re-pair if needed), then try OFF again.

**Retry publish:** master is now **9.0.680** (P2301 crash fix + softer Athom draft-wait so a `processing_failed` sibling does not hard-block promotion).

Please watch Homey Test for **9.0.680+**, then update / restart the app and retest OFF.

**Homey Test publish OK** — Auto-Publish for **9.0.680** succeeded (tip may already show **9.0.681** after the bot bump).

Please update Universal Tuya Test, restart the app if needed, then retest AC **OFF**. The stack-overflow crash on OFF should be gone.

I have now updated to 9.0.684 and re-paired the device. I can now see the temperature reading from the thermostat and turn the AC on but adjust the target temp or trying to turn the AC OFF still do not work. I have uploaded another diagnostic for you f84180b7-6cc7-4cdd-8bc5-003e80f23a62

Thank you for all your hard work!

**P2302 from diag `f84180b7` (9.0.684)** — root causes found:

1. Device was on **BHT path** (not FCU) so mode/fan listeners never armed
2. Generic EF00 mapped **bool DP1 → measure_temperature=0** and tried `onoff=0` as a number (Homey rejected it)
3. **TUYA-FRAG** treated DP24 temp `[0,0,0,220]` as a 220-byte fragment and discarded the payload
4. Setpoint/OFF can be ignored while MCU is in **schedule** — we now force **manual (DP101)** before TX

Fix is on master **9.0.685** and publishing to Homey Test. Please update, restart the app (or re-pair once), then retest **OFF** and **target temp**.

If anything still fails, send a fresh diagnostic ID.

**P2303 for Adam K (`xDMcGee`) — follow-up on diag `f84180b7`**

Your Homey Self-Hosted log showed the thermostat stuck on the **BHT** path (empty `zb_manufacturer_name`) even though it is a TYBAC FCU (`_TZE204_mpbki2zm` + `TS0601`). DP36 (valve) proved it was FCU hardware.

**Extra hardening in Test `9.0.687+`:**
1. Arm FCU automatically when DP28 / DP36 / DP101 appears (or Basic cluster identity)
2. Persist FCU arm in device store across restarts
3. TX via **DeviceIO cascade** (not cluster-only) for OFF + setpoint
4. Always force **manual mode (DP101)** before OFF / target temp (schedule was swallowing commands)

**Please:**
1. Update Universal Tuya Test to **9.0.687+** (wait a few minutes if 9.0.686 is still showing)
2. Restart the app once (re-pair only if still stuck)
3. Retest **OFF** and **target temperature**

If anything fails, send a new diagnostic ID — I will keep iterating until OFF + setpoint work.
9.0.690 also soft-fails a Homey flow serializer crash (Invalid Driver ID virtualdriverzigbee) seen on older Test builds. Please retest FCU OFF/setpoint on latest Test after update.
P2308 from Gmail crash harvest: extra recursion guard on SafeCapabilityMixin + setCapabilityValue depth cap. Please update Test to **9.0.694+** and retest FCU OFF/setpoint.

**Status check for @xDMcGee (Adam)**

Tip Test is now **9.0.696+** (includes P2300–P2303 FCU path + P2308 recursion guards from your Gmail/diags `8c49c683` / `f84180b7`).

Please:
1. Update Test → https://homey.app/a/com.dlnraja.tuya.zigbee/test/
2. Confirm ≥ **9.0.696** (or at least **9.0.694+**)
3. Restart app once (re-pair only if still stuck on BHT/empty mfr)
4. Retest **OFF** + **target temperature**

Product page you listed: https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005005866919886.html (`_TZE204_mpbki2zm` + `TS0601`).

If OFF/setpoint still fail, send a **new diagnostic ID** — I’ll keep iterating.

I have updated to 6.0.699, restarted and repaired but still only the ON functionality is working. Set OFF/Target temp not working. Here is a new diagnostic for you a095345e-08a4-4d5e-b3b1-adbc30ff12a2
Thank you!

**P2324 follow-up on diag `a095345e` (Adam)**

Root cause for ON-ok / OFF+setpoint-dead on TYBAC FCU (`_TZE204_mpbki2zm`+`TS0601`):
1. Blind DP101 (manual) before every TX — Z2M still marks DP101 as TODO; MCU can ignore DP1=false / DP16
2. Soft-success TX + hollow EF00 after re-pair

**Fix in next Test tip:** DP1/DP16 first; DP101 only after RX confirms it; force magic handshake + IEEE heal on FCU boot; hard-fail if mesh TX fails.

Please update Test when Athom publishes the tip, restart app once, retest **OFF** + **target temperature**. If still stuck, send a fresh diagnostic.

**P2326 follow-up — diag `a095345e` (Adam) on Test **9.0.699****

Log shows FCU path is alive:

- OFF TX: `onoff TX false ok` and DP1 RX `false` (mesh ACK)
- Then DynCap **wrongly** mapped **DP36** (3-way valve) → `target_temperature` and wrote `5`

So the “setpoint dead / jumps” symptom on 9.0.699 is partly **DynCap inventing a mapping** for a driver-owned FCU DP, not only missing OFF TX.

Fixes on master (next Test after Athom recovers from draft hang):

1. P2324 — FCU TX order (DP1/DP16 before DP101; hard-fail soft TX)
2. P2326 — DynCap **skips driver-owned DPs**; DP36 reserved as internal valve

Please update to the newest Universal Tuya Test tip when Athom shows it (live tip was still **9.0.719** while **9.0.721** sat in draft after socket hang). Then remove + re-pair Wall Thermostat and retest OFF + target temp.

If still broken, send a fresh diag after the re-pair.
